scope: Documented copy/support relations relevant to the Hodgson paper project, beginning with Cambridge Buddhist Sanskrit manuscript evidence and one explicit Hodgson archetype chain.
analytical_rule: Textual genealogy and support transition are coded separately. A copy relation does not imply support change; different supports do not imply copy lineage.

catalogue_evidence: The last leaf is much mutilated, and is supplied by a paper leaf.
The paper supply appears to be a copy of the real last leaf when it was in a rather more perfect condition.
Bendall states that the modern hand and paper demonstrate a copied date and interprets it as testimony to the antiquity of the perishing original leaf.
